{{Top|leg}}
A '''quartermaster droid''' was a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. They were responsible for overseeing the storage and distribution of equipment and weaponry aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. [[Bossikan/Rendili]] produced the [[R-97 Quartermaster Droid]].<ref name="TDC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref>
